evidence.title: Remove Background from Image for Free – remove.bg
About remove.bg: our story, vision & mission | remove.bg

name: remove.bg
summary: AI service that removes image backgrounds automatically in seconds.
description: Upload a photo and remove.bg erases the background automatically, producing transparent PNGs, white backgrounds or refined cutouts with Magic Brush. Free for basic use, with paid plans and a developer API for HD output, automation and volume. Founded in 2018, part of Canva.
contains: free basic removal; paid plans unlock max quality and scale
use cases: individuals, photographers, marketing, ecommerce, car dealerships, enterprise
